title: Microsoft Edge: expanded enforcement controls for Data Loss Prevention connectors
notes: claim 60: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and documented control names and paths are supported, and searches confirmed the stated gaps for the planned controls. Two descriptive assurances go beyond the evidence: that the connector takes no independent actions and that users would notice only justification or guidance prompts.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Why it matters; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The upload policy's block_until_verdict and default_action fields configure waiting for analysis and the error fallback, using Group Policy or registry.
claims.quote:
block_until_verdict If set to 1, Microsoft Edge waits for a response from the analysis service before giving the page access to the data.
default_action If set to block, Microsoft Edge denies page access to the data if an error occurs while contacting the analysis service.
